The NGT also noted violations of the Environment (Protection) Act related to these concerns, prompting the inclusion of several government bodies as respondents in the proceedings.

recent_articles.title: 26 candidates bag perfect 100 NTA score in JEE-Main - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NTA** announced that 26 candidates achieved a perfect score of 100 on the JEE-Main entrance exam, surpassing last year's total.  Over 13 lakh candidates took the exam in two sessions, with more than eight lakh appearing in both. The scores are normalized across shifts and range from 100 to 0 for each shift. The candidates, all males, hail from various states including Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Rajasthan, Delhi, Maharashtra, Haryana, Chandigarh, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, Odisha, and Gujarat.

recent_articles.title: PCR tests for amoebic fever now at Kozhikode MCH’s microbiology lab - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Government Medical College Hospital** in Kozhikode has equipped its microbiology lab with facilities to conduct PCR tests for the identification of Naegleria fowleri, Acanthamoeba spp., and Balamuthia mandrillaris. This allows for species identification and confirmation of amoebic meningoencephalitis directly at the hospital, eliminating the need for sending samples to other labs.  The lab has already tested a majority of samples for Acanthamoeba spp., with 83 cases of amoebic meningoencephalitis and 15 deaths reported in the state this year.

recent_articles.title: Consolidated voters’ list of 9 States and 3 UTs that underwent SIR Phase II trimmed by 10.2% - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India** announced the results of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in nine states and three Union Territories. **Uttar Pradesh** recorded the highest net deletion of voters at 2.04 crore, followed by **West Bengal**, with a net deletion of 83.86 lakh. The SIR phase II identified 67 lakh deceased voters and 1.28 crore duplicate voters across these states and UTs.  The consolidated electoral rolls saw a reduction of 10.2%, bringing the number of active voters down to 45.81 crore.

recent_articles.title: Andhra Pradesh can emerge as golfing capital: PGTI - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Khalin Joshi** won the Andhra Open Golf Championship in Visakhapatnam, securing his seventh professional title and a ₹15 lakh prize. **Amandeep Johl**, CEO of the Professional Golf Tour of India (PGTI), believes **Andhra Pradesh** has the potential to become a golfing capital due to its coastline, climate, and government support.  He suggests developing 10-12 courses across the state could generate up to $2 billion in economic activity and attract high-value visitors.

recent_articles.title: ‘Didn’t spend a penny’: INLD accuses Haryana govt. of gross financial mismanagement - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sampat Singh**, a former **Finance Minister** and national patron of the **Indian National Lok Dal (INLD)**, accused the **BJP government** of gross financial mismanagement in its 2025-26 budget. He claimed that despite allocating funds for various schemes, including agriculture, rural development, healthcare, education, and urban housing, no expenditure was incurred.  Singh also alleged that officials were investing funds in fixed deposits with low returns while the government borrowed at higher interest rates. The **BJP** responded by calling the allegations "politically motivated" and highlighting the highest budget expenditure under their regime compared to previous governments.

recent_articles.title: Assembly elections 2026: ECI may roll out SIR in remaining 17 States, 5 UTs post polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission** is considering rolling out the third and final phase of Special Intensive Revision (SIR) for voters' lists in 22 states and Union territories after the Assembly elections this month. The exercise, which aims to clean up electoral rolls, could begin after the polls conclude on April 29th or after the declaration of results.  The **Election Commission** has already conducted SIR in 10 states and three Union Territories, covering nearly 60 crore voters.

recent_articles.title: Chandigarh grenade blast case solved, claims Punjab DGP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Punjab** police, in collaboration with **Chandigarh** police, arrested five individuals suspected of involvement in a grenade attack outside the **BJP** office in Chandigarh on April 1st. The suspects were apprehended following a joint operation and recovered one hand grenade and a .30 bore Zigana pistol along with ammunition from their possession.  Preliminary investigations revealed that the group was backed by **Pakistan's ISI** and operated under foreign-based handlers located in Portugal and Germany, according to **Punjab**’s Director General of Police (DGP) Gaurav Yadav.

recent_articles.title: Chandigarh: Blast outside Punjab BJP office: Two suspects identified - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Two suspects** have been identified in the blast outside the **Punjab BJP headquarters** in Chandigarh.  The explosion occurred on Wednesday, April 1st, 2026, when a suspected crude explosive device was thrown near the office. No casualties were reported and an FIR has been registered under relevant sections of the Explosives Act and Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The **National Investigation Agency (NIA)** is inspecting the site and police are searching for the suspects.  The incident has been condemned by political leaders, including **Sunil Jakhar** of the BJP and **Amrinder Singh Raja Warring**, president of the Punjab Congress.

recent_articles.title: Census 2027 kicks off: How to do self-enumeration: step-by-step guide - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner will conduct the 2027 census, a massive administrative and statistical exercise that collects demographic data on the entire country. The self-enumeration facility allows citizens to provide their household information online before enumerators visit, offering flexibility in filling out the census schedule.  The dates for self-enumeration vary by state and union territory, with most starting in April 2026. Census data is expected to be published within 2027 due to the digital nature of the process.

recent_articles.title: Vaibhav Suryavanshi: The 15-year-old Indian that cricket can no longer ignore
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The 15-year-old Indian batter Vaibhav Suryavanshi is poised to make history as the youngest player in the IPL.  **Suryavanshi**, who turned 15 on March 27th, has already made a name for himself with impressive performances at various youth levels and his recent century in the IPL. The question now is whether he's ready for the world stage.  His talent has been recognized by many former cricketers, including Ravi Shastri, AB de Villiers, Matthew Hayden, WV Raman, and Sachin Tendulkar, who have praised his skills and maturity.

recent_articles.title: Gurugram rape case: Supreme Court criticises Haryana Police’s insensitive handling of four-year-old child’s rape case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** reprimanded the **Haryana Police** and its child welfare committee for their insensitive handling of a four-year-old's rape case. The Court, after hearing parents' allegations of inaction by the Gurugram police, ordered the constitution of a three-member Special Investigation Team (SIT) with women IPS officers from the Haryana cadre to investigate the case.  The Court also directed the **Haryana Government** to expedite the notification of the SIT and demanded the handover of case records by March 26, 2026. The Court expressed outrage over the police's handling of the case, including summoning the victim to the station instead of visiting her home, and issued show-cause notices to Gurugram Police officials for their shoddy probe.

recent_articles.title: Chandigarh at 75: ‘It’s a testament to modern India’s vision of planned development,’ says Governor Kataria - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gulab Chand Kataria**, the **Punjab Governor** and **Chandigarh Administrator**, praised Chandigarh as a model of balanced urban living during its 75th anniversary celebration. He highlighted the city's unique character, achieved through planned growth, cleanliness, green spaces, and civic infrastructure improvements.  The event honored the first group of 12 Indian modernists who contributed to the city’s planning and development, with family members receiving recognition for their deceased relatives.

recent_articles.title: Opposition seeks arrest of AAP leader in Punjab - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Opposition parties** in Punjab pressured the ruling **Aam Aadmi Party** to arrest their senior leader, **Laljit Singh Bhullar**, following the death of a state warehousing corporation official who allegedly committed suicide after accusing him of harassment. The deceased's family demanded his arrest and refused to perform the last rites until he is apprehended.  The opposition parties, including the Indian National Congress, Bharatiya Janata Party, and Shiromani Akali Dal, staged protests demanding justice and called for an investigation by the Central Bureau of Investigation.
